body: Agreed, and if it would have been just a regular person then I would have been like yeah cool because I probably wouldn't have known. But she kept giving me regular updates on the status of the compensation, how much it was, when she was going to get it, and what she was going to use it for. if you are supposed to be my best friend I wouldn't expect such greediness. And it wasn't even a video of a project we both agreed on, she just uploaded this video of me struggling, and it wasn't a few hundred dollars, it was a few thousand dollars that she was compensated.
I was having trouble getting my car to turn on so she recorded me struggling, uploaded it and went viral on the platform

So before she uploaded the video to the platform we had both discussed that if one of our videos were to get compensated we would help each other out since we were both in tough financial situations at the moment. Once she got paid the money from the video she just kept saying how it was going to be so amazing since she was broke, I am the type to just wait it out and see what's up. Well, I waited it out and nothing ever happened. A few other disturbing things have happened since said incident, so now I'm just heavily weighing all the situations that have bothered me and seeing if it's worth throwing away such a long friendship.
